## About
DynaSport was founded by enthusiasts to serve enthusiasts. We own BMW and MINI cars ourselves, and we think the way your car is serviced should be as special as the car.
We handle full service, repairs, stock and performance parts, and performance modifications for MINI and all ranges of BMW. From a simple oil change to getting a car ready for the track, every car gets our full attention.
You can find us in NW Portland near the Pearl District, open weekdays. Customers have given us a 4.6 rating on Google from 50 reviews.

## Services
- Service and repairs: Full service and repairs for your BMW or MINI.
- Performance systems: We don't just bolt on parts. We work with top level performance manufacturers to put together a system that suits how you drive.
- Track preparation: Getting your BMW or MINI ready for time on the track.

## FAQ
Q: Which cars do you work on?
A: Every 2002 and newer MINI and all ranges of BMW.

Q: Where are you located?
A: In NW Portland, near the Pearl District.
